## About
Roessler Equipment Company is a family owned and operated Commercial HVAC equipment supplier serving the greater Houston region. Charles Bradbury Roessler, known as Charlie, started the business from his home as a Commercial HVAC Representative, moved to an office on Louisiana Street downtown, then bought the property on Schumacher Lane. We're still at that same location.
Over the years we've grown beyond being just an equipment supplier. Our full-time service team handles VFD and gas monitoring issues. We also offer cooling tower refurbishment, Gas/Refrigerant Monitoring system repair, panel and enclosure fabrication, and VFD training classes.
Brands we carry include ABB, Bosch-FHP, Critical Room Control, Flow-Tech, Honeywell-Vulcain, LAKOS, Magic Aire/RECO, Mueller, Proco Products, REYMSA Cooling Towers and Teco-Westinghouse.

## Services
- Diagnostics and Repairs for all Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs): Troubleshooting and repair on all Variable Frequency Drives.
- Preventative Maintenance on all VFDs: Scheduled maintenance to keep your drives running.
- Soft Charging on all VFDs: Soft charging service for all VFDs.
- ABB VFD Installations & Start-ups: Installation and start-up of ABB drives.
- Chemical Free Water Treatment: We provide, install and service Flow Tech chemical free water treatment. It replaces the need for costly and hazardous chemicals and allows for water and energy savings.
- Gas Detection: Gas Detection Start-ups, plus diagnostics and repairs for all gas detection devices.
- Panel + Enclosure Fabrication: Custom panels and enclosure services for our clients.
- Inventory + Will Call: We keep stock on hand to serve your immediate needs. Call ahead and pick up.

## FAQ
Q: Do you take after-hours emergency calls?
A: Yes. Our technicians are available for after-hour emergency calls for VFD and gas monitoring issues.

Q: Do you keep items in stock?
A: Yes. We stock items to serve your immediate needs. Call us and we'll check before you head over.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday.
